agent_connections_limits.name: agent_connections_limits
agent_connections_limits.value: "agent_connections"."per_purchase_minor" > 0 and "agent_connections"."per_purchase_minor" <= "agent_connections"."total_minor" and ("agent_connections"."ask_above_minor" is null or "agent_connections"."ask_above_minor" between 1 and "agent_connections"."per_purchase_minor")

agent_connections_approved.name: agent_connections_approved
agent_connections_approved.value: "agent_connections"."state" <> 'APPROVED' or ("agent_connections"."mandate_id" is not null and "agent_connections"."user_id" is not null)

agent_connections_once.name: agent_connections_once
agent_connections_once.value: "agent_connections"."kind" <> 'once' or ("agent_connections"."parent_mandate_id" is not null and "agent_connections"."user_id" is not null and octet_length("agent_connections"."cart_hash") = 32)

purchases_paypal_transaction_id_live.name: purchases_paypal_transaction_id_live
purchases_paypal_transaction_id_live.value: "purchases"."paypal_transaction_id" is null or "purchases"."live_store" is not null
